description: This source file is a Perl module ('DiffHighlight') designed for visualizing and highlighting differences in text, especially diff outputs. It includes functions for handling terminal color sequences, parsing diff hunks, and applying custom highlighting styles.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes each line of input, managing diff hunks and graph lines, and dispatches lines to the callback.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the current diff hunks, calling the show_hunk function with queued removed and added lines.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads from STDIN line-by-line, processes diff lines, and performs highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git config, with a fallback default.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk by highlighting differences between old and new lines.

methods.name: highlight_pair
methods.description: Highlights matching and differing parts of two lines, respecting color codes.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a diff line into components, including color segments.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Applies highlighting to a specific line segment based on theme.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines has meaningful differences worth highlighting.
